profile.tagline: The musical bridge between Southern Africa & the US.
profile.short_bio: DJ Eddie Ed (djedyed) is a New York–based DJ and music curator who has spent more than two decades connecting Southern African dance music with American crowds. A Botswana National DJ '98 mix show champion and an early champion of kwaito in the US, he has played Central Park SummerStage, NJPAC and, in 2023, the Apollo Theater in Harlem.
profile.full_bio:
Eddie Ed grew up between Zimbabwe, Botswana and South Africa, and he brought those dancefloors with him to New York.

He won the Botswana National DJ '98 mix show championship, then held down the famous after-work party Naked Lunch “Share Libations” from 2000 to 2004. In 2001 he became the first kwaito-exclusive DJ to play Central Park SummerStage, and in 2002–03 he played NJPAC and the African Film Festival.

His sets run from kwaito, Afro house and amapiano through zimdancehall, ndombolo and Afrobeat, across deep and soulful house, soul and R&B, hip-hop, reggae and old-school classics.

On February 23, 2023 he DJ'd the South African cocktail reception at the Apollo Theater for ImageNation's Cocktails & Sol Cinema screening of Mbongeni Ngema's Asinamali, then played the official after party at Shrine World Music Venue in Harlem.
